title: The {key:"}{key::} and {key:"}{key:.} registers
summary: Last Ex command and last inserted text are registers you can paste.

frames.caption: After `:echo hi`, the command lives in {key:"}{key::}.
From *insert mode,* {key:Ctrl-R}{key::} pastes the last Ex command.
frames.narration: Special registers are read-only mirrors of recent editor state — handy when you want to reuse a command or a typed phrase.
